solutions.title: Partial product strings
solutions.strategy: Build one shifted partial product per multiplier digit and add it into the running string result.

timeComplexity.explanation: For each multiplier digit, a partial product and string addition can touch the product length.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The largest partial product and running result are bounded by the output digit count.

solutions.title: Shared digit array
solutions.strategy: Accumulate each digit-pair product directly into its grade-school array positions.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every pair of input digits contributes once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The result array has at most `m + n` digits.
